description: Compute per-account and overall credit utilization (balance / limit) from one or more credit accounts, plus a qualitative tier matching common credit-scoring guidance: under 10% is excellent, under 30% is good (the generally recommended ceiling), under 50% is fair, and 50%+ is poor. Overall utilization is total balance over total limit, not an average of the per-account percentages.

accounts.description: A non-empty list of credit accounts

name: calculate_credit_utilization
